summary: Round 3 (r3b1): 30.233 (incumbent 28.841): the greedy line flies through the -y tunnel, the room, under *20 to the void's bottom (x ~900-1,250), first time past 28.9% on this map. Diagnosis: with 0.5 units/s of time penalty and free death, dying is optimal at every dip gate (CP2 pit dive beats detour+tunnel dive by 0.5 units; a dive that dies at the tunnel end loses nothing). Fix (generic, from the trainer's own constants): --fail-pen 10 = time_pen/(1-gamma) (death = never finishing; objective = discounted progress + survival), --surf-bonus 0 (a farm in that frame), T 0 (--unstuck-max 0), --eval-stall 1 (evals blocked training). Incumbent ckpt + those flags: pit lock gone in ~150M steps, tunnel passed by a bounce at the window (~380M), void bottom by ~830M; training ceiling 31.6%. Continuing r3b1_ifpx.
